scope: Deterministic Node VM checks of actual loader with synthetic fetch/media and clock. No browser decoder, audible playback, Android UI, emulator or gameplay execution.

checks.name: Complete assigned track becomes Blob media; native engine music stays disabled
Hung single-track fetch ends with retry message and aborted request
On restarts an unresolved fetch immediately, before timeout or error
A response whose body never finishes is also bounded and explicitly retryable
Never-settling play promise times out and a later On restarts it
On also restarts a pending play promise before an error exists
Resolved play promise without playing event cannot leave startup unbounded
Decoder/play rejection is nonfatal and only explicit On retries
Repeated stalled events cannot perpetually extend buffering deadline
Playback recovery clears a buffering deadline
Off aborts pending IO; ignored late fetch completion cannot create audio
Background aborts fetch; resume uses fresh current metadata
Off, hidden document and disposal each release Blob/player without changing native audio
Disposed player ignores late play promise and media events
Truncated track and partial HTTP response fail without exposing media Blob
Retained Duel initialization still uses its native playlist path
